title: ILM 902BT Pearl White

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Engineered for adaptable touring, the Ilm 902BT Pearl White is delivers one-handed chin bar actuation paired with certified dual-homologation protection across highway and urban riding. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at 1634g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~89 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Best-selling budget modular with integrated Bluetooth and FM radio.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Modular design allows for easy adjustment; Pearl White finish is standard.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Ilm ILM 902BT Pearl White: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Ilm's Modular lineup, the ILM 902BT Pearl White brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Ilm 902BT Pearl White represents Ilm's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~89 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Modular helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Ilm 902BT Pearl White delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
